==Flavor Text==

''An orange glow in the dark, and a wet smell of rotting fruit.''

==About==

A {{i|Jack-o-Lantern}} is the product of a second growth stage, third tier {{i|Pumpkin}} Harvest. Right-clicking a Jack-o-Lantern and selecting "Slice" will give you 4x {{i|Pumpkin Flesh}} and 10x {{i|Seeds of Pumpkin}}. A Jack-o-Lantern can be stored in a {{i|Stockbin}}.
